outer.visualRationale: Destination-first hierarchy, large bounded Yokohama photography, strong native Japanese masthead, deliberate photo overlap, compact timeline and asymmetric back-cover photo field outperform the more formal B silhouette for the requested Rurubu-like energy.

inside.visualRationale: Large profile atmosphere, native identity copy, unequal question scales, waterfront timeline, and overlapping three-role memory collage preserve dense-readable rhythm without reintroducing V5 card geometry.

assetEvidence.strategy: Reuse only previously Drive/Figma-verified Rurubu raster roles because the current bottleneck was macro-composition and editorial hierarchy, not missing photography. No blocked binary transport route was retried.

status.next: Continue visual improvement from V6 A/A using screenshot evidence; new image generation is warranted only when a concrete role remains bottlenecked after composition/crop/typography work. Final vendor-template/real-content production readiness remains a separate gate.
